tasks.title: heartbeat dismisses this session's own pending needs_input lines
tasks.notes: notification-log.sh writes needs_input on idle_prompt; nothing clears it when the user answers, so next --loop defers on its own session (dismissed by hand 3x on 2026-10-12). On PostToolBatch rewrite this session pending needs_input/permission lines to dismissed (atomic tmp+mv). Other sessions lines untouched.

tasks.title: tasks.sh: set depends_on and add-verify after add
tasks.notes: No way to add a dependency or a verify command post-add (owed-cleanups T-002/T-003 ordering). "set <slug> <id> depends_on=T-1,T-3" (ids must exist, reject cycles) and "add-verify <slug> <id> cmd::timeout" (resets passes=false).

tasks.title: Registry rows run in any repo layout
tasks.notes: det-01 has a literal HEAD~N; det-05/07/09/10 (stacks *) grep src/ and exit 2 without it; check:test-tamper ends in "[ ] && echo" so a clean run exits 1 (= finding). Use ${BLITZ_BASE:-origin/main}..HEAD, scan ${CHANGED} with a git ls-files fallback, make test-tamper exit 0 when clean per its exit contract.

tasks.title: block-destructive-git force-push match stays inside one command
tasks.notes: The force-push pattern allows any gap between "push" and the flag, so a later "rm -f" after a semicolon trips it (2026-10-12, twice; also blocked a tasks.sh call whose notes quoted that shape). Bound the gap to a class without ; & |. Bats: push-then-semicolon-rm passes; push with -f or --force to main still blocks.
